6131.title: ACP forms lose optional-property semantics
6131.rootCauseOneLine: The ACP planner ignores the required-property list, counts raw properties, and declines missing answers; the shared interaction validator also requires every displayed question to be answered.
6131.proposedFix: Preserve required-property semantics through presentation and submission, omit unanswered optional values, and count displayed questions after any explicit companion folding. Generic optionality requires a cross-subsystem contract change or a product decision, so no simple-fix PR is safe.
6131.caveats: Reproduced at the real ACP planner boundary twice, not with a live external provider or desktop app. Regression assertions intentionally fail on unchanged main.
